GOOD TO KNOW

A few answers
before you ask.

Less figuring things out.
More pressing play.

Is Y2Audio free to use?+

Yes. You can convert supported videos without creating an account or paying a subscription. Usage limits help keep the service available for everyone.

What’s the difference between MP3 and MP4?+

MP3 saves just the audio and usually makes a smaller file. MP4 saves both video and audio. Choose MP3 for listening or MP4 for watching.

Which links and video lengths work?+

Use a link to a public YouTube video or Short up to 10 minutes long. Playlists, live streams, and videos that require signing in are not supported.

What quality can I download?+

Choose 128 or 192 kbps for MP3, or up to 360p or 720p for MP4. Available video quality depends on the source. Converting cannot improve the original recording’s quality.

How long is my download available?+

Your link expires 30 minutes after conversion finishes. Temporary files are automatically deleted. Save the file to your device before the link expires.
